title: BERN02 Exercises: Reproducible Regression and GLM Workflows
description: Reproducible Jupyter notebook workflows for a linear regression analysis of bird count data and a generalized linear model (GLM) analysis of pollution data, developed as coursework for the BERN02 module. Includes pinned dependencies, documented data provenance, and a discussion of adherence to FAIR data principles.
notes: Data files included under data/ are described in data/pollution_metadata.txt. Check original data source terms before reuse if applicable.
